claim: Games and the ROM routines they call may read the ROM area where hooks would sit; run the ROM path check before placing code there.

evidence.text: ROM calls run the calculator at 2Dxx; nextboot.rom_paths found it and entries moved to free space at 3880.
39194 copies ROM onto itself; one caller passes BC=16384, so it reads the alt ROM's hook bytes (harmless, accepted).
ROM reads: only 0x3500-0x3508 (ROM 0), once, by the bank-3 sound code at 49204.
A game that reads the alt ROM as data pays for every library byte there; the library can assemble anywhere.
